get_document.description: Fetch a single Documents & Reports record by its document id (the 'id' returned by the search action) or by the long number at the end of its documents.worldbank.org URL.

document.abstracts: The World Development Report 2025, titled "Standards for Development," emphasizes the critical role of standards as an invisible infrastructure for modern economies, essential for prosperity, export growth, technology diffusion, and resilient public services.
document.display_title: World Development Report 2025 : Standards for Development

get_document.name: get_document

parameters.description: The document's id, for example '40078019' (the 'id' field returned by the search action), or the long number at the end of its documents.worldbank.org URL (its 'guid'), for example '099122125121523841'.
parameters.name: document_id

parameters.description: Optional comma-separated list of fields to return. Leave empty for the same standard set a search returns (title, date, country, type, language, abstract, URLs, and more), or use '*' for every field the API holds.
parameters.name: fields

list_facets.description: List the most common values (up to 100 per field, with counts) found across all matching documents for one or more facetable fields, for example the countries or languages present. Handy for discovering the exact values to filter a search on.
list_facets.display_str_template: List World Bank document facet values.
list_facets.name: list_facets

parameters.description: Choose at least one facetable field to tally, for example Country and Language.
parameters.name: facets

parameters.description: Optional free-text query to narrow the facet counts to matching documents. Leave empty to tally across the whole corpus.
parameters.name: query

search_documents.description: Search the World Bank Documents & Reports corpus. Use a free-text query and/or narrow by country, document type, language, project, title, or date range. Results are paginated and each record includes its title, URL, and any extra fields you request.

documents.abstracts: The objective of the Wind Umbrella (La Venta II) Project aims to reduce greenhouse gases emissions from power generation in Mexico and promote investment in wind energy in Mexico to diversify the sources of power generation in the country.
documents.display_title: Mexico - Wind Umbrella (La Venta II) Project
documents.repnme: Mexico - Wind Umbrella (La Venta II) Project

documents.abstracts: The development objective of the Mocha Wind Park Project for Yemen is to increase the supply of cost-effective renewable wind electricity.

search_documents.name: search_documents

parameters.description: Free-text search (the API's 'qterm'). Matches a document's title, abstract, report or project number, country, and other core fields, for example 'wind turbine'. Every word must match; wrap words in double quotes to match an exact phrase. Leave empty to match all documents (newest first).
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Restrict to documents whose country field exactly matches this name, capitalization included, for example 'Argentina'. Match several countries by separating them with a caret, for example 'Russian Federation^Armenia'. 'List facet values' shows the exact names.
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: Restrict to an exact document type, capitalization included, for example 'Procurement Plan' or 'Project Appraisal Document'.
parameters.name: document_type

parameters.description: Restrict to documents in this language, capitalization included, for example 'English' or 'French'.
parameters.name: language

parameters.description: Restrict to the documents of a World Bank project, by the ID on its projects.worldbank.org page, for example 'P178329'. Separate several with commas.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: Restrict to documents whose display title contains any of these words, for example 'wind energy'. Wrap them in double quotes, as in '"wind energy"', to require the exact phrase.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: Only documents dated on or after this date. Use 'YYYY-MM-DD' or 'MM-DD-YYYY', for example '2018-01-01'. Leave empty for no earliest date.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Only documents dated on or before this date. Use 'YYYY-MM-DD' or 'MM-DD-YYYY', for example '2018-03-30'. Leave empty for no latest date.
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return per record, for example 'docdt,count,authors'. The id, guid, title and URLs are always returned too. Leave empty for a standard set (title, date, country, type, language, abstract, report and project numbers, and URLs), or use '*' for every field the API holds, a much larger response.
parameters.name: fields

parameters.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to relevance when a query is given, otherwise document date (newest first).
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.description: Sort direction. Only applies when 'Sort by' is set.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: How many documents to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 10.
parameters.name: rows

parameters.description: Zero-based index of the first result to return, for paging, up to 100,000. Defaults to 0. For example, 20 starts the second page when returning 20 rows.
parameters.name: offset

description: Search and retrieve public documents and reports from the World Bank's Documents & Reports collection using the free, keyless World Bank WDS API. No account or API key required. Look up documents by topic, country, type, language, or date; fetch a single record by id; and list facet values to discover how to filter.
